hooks.name: Safety review on edit
hooks.description: When a safety-critical file changes, Kiro double-checks the change against the product safety rules.

action.prompt: A safety-critical MakeWeight file was just saved. Review the change against .kiro/steering/product.md: (1) safety limits only change in js/limits.js and still match the universal rules (1%/week fat, 3%/week red, 5% water cap, recovery<33, RHR +7, sleep<70); (2) nothing recommends a banned method (vomiting, salt/hot baths, saunas/steam, rubber suits, diuretics, laxatives, spitting, zero fluids); (3) every recommendation still cites a source key from js/sources.js; (4) the water loading warning (hyponatremia, adults-only research, NFHS, not medical professionals) is intact; (5) the AI coach still receives numbers only. Report any problem briefly and suggest a fix.
